visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A white cat with black spots on its head and a grey and white cat sit on a wooden staircase behind a glass gate. The white cat stands on its hind legs, pawing vigorously at the glass with its front paws, while the grey cat watches calmly. The setting is a brightly lit indoor home with white walls and stairs. Large white text overlays the center, and a logo appears in the upper right. (2) The camera shifts to a high-angle view looking down at the wooden stairs. A ginger tabby cat and a calico cat are now visible, looking up expectantly with wide eyes and twitching whiskers. The wooden grain of the steps is clear under the bright artificial light. Smaller yellow text captions appear near the cats' heads as they move. (3) In a tight close-up, the white cat with black spots meows and scratches at the glass barrier with its pink paw pads visible. Its green eyes are wide and focused. A calico cat is partially visible in the background on a lower step. White subtitles with a black outline appear at the bottom of the frame. (4) A human hand enters from the bottom right, holding a small treat dispenser. It drops a small, light-colored freeze-dried cube onto the wooden floor surface. The ginger tabby cat immediately snaps its head toward the object, its ears forward and body tensed. The lighting creates soft shadows on the floor. (5) The camera provides a close-up of the ginger tabby cat as it lowers its head to the floor and eats the treat with a quick biting motion. The wooden floor and the white metal frame of the glass gate are visible in the background. Final text displays on a solid pink background with the brand name in white.
